content: Yona inepneep ila iigh tiina apo lolo, ve isuŋ pa Maaron toni Yoova ighaze:

content.text: “Sawa to nanepneep ila pataŋani tiina lolo, you nataŋ roran Yoova.
Ve ye ilooŋ aliŋag ve iuul ghou.
Yoova, you nanepneep ila ndug to yes mateeŋa, ve taŋiiz tiou iŋarua ghom naghaze uul ghou.
Ve yom ulooŋ taŋiiz tiou.
Yom upandalin ghou le nazila mazovan to sila kat we.
Ve te itatab ghou, ve waŋaar ighereb ghou nala nanim,
ve dibom tiom tintina tipol tizala poghog.
You nagham ŋgar naghaze yom undiir ghou pa naghom wa.
Eemoghon naghur ila naghaze pale naghita rumai tiom patabuaŋ muul.
Dibom ipol izala poghog, ve itatab ghou.
Ve waŋaar to te lolo ililiit ghou, ve aniiŋ to pon ikaukau dabag.
You nazila lolooz pughu to sila we.
Ndug samia tonowen ikis ghou le nagham ŋgar naghaze irau naza muul maau.
Eemoghon Maaron tiou Yoova, yom undae ghou naza.
Tauto namaat ve nazila ndug to mateeŋa maau, ve aazne naneep matag iyaryaar.
“Yoova, sawa to tapirig ighaze isob, you matag iŋgal ghom, ve suŋuuŋ tiou iŋarua ghom.
Ve yom unepneep ila rumai tiom patabuaŋ lolo, ve ulooŋ ghou.
“Yes to timbesmbees pa maaron kaaromŋa, tighur muridi pa poia to Maaron.
Tauto irau tighita anoŋa eta maau.
“Eemoghon you lolog poia pa ulaaŋ tiom. Tovenen nambou pa napait ghom, ve nagham watooŋrau payom.
Ve mbeb tisob to nambua saveeŋ toman ghom pa nagham di, you pale nagham di.
Yoova, yom moghon to Volaaŋa tiou.”

content: Ghoro Yoova isaav pa iigh tiina tonowen, ve ila iluar Yona izi naari.
